integrity.scientific_method: Explicit elementary simplicial collapses, integral fundamental cycle, exact signed Lefschetz traces, and reproducible standalone enumeration.

scientific_limitations: Exact seven-vertex pentagonal-bipyramid matching complex only; no classification of larger bipyramids, no integral representation decomposition, and no global priority guarantee. The published classification of manifold matching complexes is not a classification of all matching complexes with manifold homotopy type.
title: A ten-collapse torus core and symmetry character for the pentagonal-bipyramid matching complex
